about.title: Umufasha w’abahereza ku Gitekerezo Gikuru.
about.lead: King Business Studio ifasha abucuruzi n’abahereza kugaragaza akazi kabo neza — hifashishwe amanduku, ugaragaza n’websites zifite umurongo w’abahereza, bikaba zinyuzwe kugira ngo bikoreshwe.
about.aboutText:
King Business Studio (KBS) ni ikigo gikora mu bicece bitatu: amanduku y’ubucuruzi, ugaragaza ibinyabiziga, n’ubunyangamugayo b’website. Akazi gahinga ku gicece kimwe — CV cyangwa logo — kugeza ku marwi y’ikigo, ibikoresho by’igihano n’websites zose.

Uburyo bwo kukora ni bwose. Twumva icyo ikigo gishaka kugerageza, twemera ingero y’akazi isobanutuwe, hanyuma dukora akazi gato. Nta byigeze bishyikirizwa ko byarangiye mbere yo kugenzurwa no kwemeza ingero.
about.missionText: Kutanga umusanzwe umwuga, ubunyangamugayo n’ubugarakari butuma abakiriya bacunguruka bagakura.
about.visionText: Kuba umufasha wizewe mu maso y’ubucuruzi n’ubunyangamugayo mu Rwanda no hanze.

meta.title: Politiki y’Ibinyamakuru | King Business Studio
meta.description: Uko King Business Studio ikusanya, ikoresha n icyo ituma amakuru ohereza kuri iyi website.

sections.title: Turi iki
paragraphs: King Business Studio ("KBS", "turi", "twe") itanga serivisi z’amanduku y’ubucuruzi, ugaragaza ibinyabiziga n’ubunyangamugayo b’website. Uyu mwanduku usobanura icyo biri no amakuru ohereza kuri iyi website.

Izina ry’ikigo, address n’email y’umuyobozi w’amakuru bitarasohotseho kuba byuzuye, kandi byongerwa mbere yo gushyirwa website ku murongo. Kuri ubu, ifashiko ry’uhoyane iri ku ipaji ya Uhoyane ni inzira yo kuguhamagara.

sections.title: Icyo dusanya
paragraphs: Uruhererekane n’isunika ry’amanduku y’ubucuruzi cyangwa ry’uhoyane, dusanya amakuru ushyizemo: amazina yawe, imbuto ya email, igihugu watanzeho, ururimi ukeneye, n’ibisobanuro by’umushinga watanze. Ibi byose bisobanuturwa ku ifashiko, kandi gusa ibyo bisanzwe gukubwa ni byo bisanzwe.
Tutabaza ibibu passwords, ibicuruzwa by’karte, indangamuntu cyangwa ibindi by’umubyinya tw’umuntu, kandi twabikira ngo ntube mu butumwa.

Ubufasha bw’abashobisha bukora entirely muri browser wawe. Ubutumwa bw’ikiganiro bibikwa gusa mu ibango rw’urupapuro rw’igifungo. Ntibwohera seriveri, ntibwikurikizwa muri base de données, kandi ntibwohera serivisi yo hanze y’AI.

sections.title: Uko dukoresha
paragraphs: Amakuru uyohereza akoreshwa kugira ngo tubibore ubusabe, twategure igiciro n’ingero y’akazi, kandi tugusubiza. Tumukoresha kuri icyo gikora gusa.
Tutagura amakuru yawe, kandi ntutukoresha kuri ibikoresho by’ubucuruzi.

sections.title: Formspree
paragraphs: Ifashiko zombi zoherezwa hakoreshwa Formspree, serivisi yo gucunga amafashiko. Urimo kohereza ifashiko, amakuru wanditse areba kuri Formspree, ibafasura mu inbox ya KBS kugira ngo tugusubize. Formspree ikora ibi ku rwacu hakurikijye amategeko yayo yo ibinyamakuru.
Ushobora gusoma politiki y’ibinyamakuru ya Formspree kuri formspree.io. Niba ntushaka ko amakuru agabana serivisi y’umwuka, twabwire iki mu butumwa kandi tuzagufata uburyo bunindi bwo kwakira.

sections.title: Igihe twabicura
paragraphs: Amakuru y’ibibazo abikurwa igihe ukenewe kugira ngo tubibore ubusabe wowe kandi twiyungeze mu by’ucuruzi. Umushinga uhumaye, twabika gusa ibyo bikenewe kubirwa ibindi n’amategeko.
Igihe cy’icyo twabicura cyasigaye gikemezwa, kandi cyakubikwa aha igihe politiki y’ubucuruzi yemezwe.

sections.title: Amahoro yawe
paragraphs: Ushobora kutubaza amakuru mfite, gusaba guhindurwa, cyangwa gusaba yoherejwe, ukoresha imbaraga iri ku ipaji ya Uhoyane. Ushobora no kutubaka kugira ngo tugende gukoresha amakuru yawe kugira ngo tugukomeze.
Ushobora gufurika ikiganiro cya umufasha wa KBS igihe icyo ukoresha ikiganza cya "Sukura ikiganiro" kiri mu kafu ya ikiganiro.

sections.title: Cookies na analytics
paragraphs: Iyi website ntibaika cookies z’ubucuruzi kandi ntikoresha trackers bw’ubucuruzi bw’umwuka. Uruhumu rwawe rururimi rukurikizwa mu browser yawe kugira ngo website ibuke ururimi watoranyijwe.

sections.title: Umutekano
paragraphs: Website ishyikirizwa kuri HTTPS mu iterambere ry’umusanzwe, kandi ifashiko zoherezwa kuri ubuvuga bw’umurongo w’ubwirinzi. Nta gahanga ko umuryango w’imutekano ugomba kuba uhumye rwose, ni byo rero ntukoze amakuru ushaka ntiyishyikizwe.

sections.title: Ihindura
paragraphs: Uyu mwanduku uhindurwa igihe uburyo website ukora ahinduka. Igitihe cy’"Byahinduwe" cyirangiye hejuru cyerekana ihindura ry’iya mberi.

meta.title: Amategeko yo Gukoresha | King Business Studio
meta.description: Amategeko akoreshwa igihe ukoresha website ya King Business Studio.

sections.title: Iyi mategeko
paragraphs: Iyi mategeko akoreshwa kuri bose bakoresha website ya King Business Studio. Ukoresha website ukemera iyi mategeko.
Izina ry’ikigo, address, amategeko y’igihugu n’ubucamanza bitarasohotseho kuba byuzuye, kandi byongerwa hano mbere yo gushyirwa website ku murongo.

sections.title: Iyi website ikora iki
paragraphs: Iyi website yerekana serivisi n’akazi bya King Business Studio, kandi itanga ifashiko yo gusaba serivisi cyangwa kuguhamagara. Twashobora guhindura ibiri ku website igihe icyo gishoboka.

sections.title: Nta bwizezi
paragraphs: Ibirimo bya website, harugamo ibisobanuro bya serivisi n’imishinga yerekana, byatanzwe kugira ngo umusanzwe w’ubumenyi. Nta byigeze bigaragaza ibintu byose nk’ibicuruzwa, igiciro cyangwa is promised ishimishwe ku mushingu runaka rw’intego.
Tutiyemeze akazi, ishoramari, funding, amasezerano, imirongo y’isearch, inyungu cyangwa ikigero gikomatanyije cy’uburyo buhinguriye ku byacu bishyushwe.

sections.title: Imishinga n’amagamuru
paragraphs: Umushinga usizeye gusa amaze ingero y’akazi, igiciro n’igihe bigaragaza mu buryo bwanditswe. Igiciro cyerekanwa ku ifashiko ni icyigero cy’ibiciro biganira, ntacyo bigiciro bishingiye.
Akazi kagaragara muri portfolio ni imishinga y’igiho (concept) na demo yakozwe na KBS kugira ngo bigeze bigaragaza ubushakashatsi. Byakandikwa koko kandi ntibyerekanwa nk’akazi bw’abakiriya.

sections.title: Ibyo biriweho n’imyitwarire
paragraphs: Uruhererekane rw’ibyo ukohereza ni rwowe. Uremeza ko ufite uburenganzira bwo kohereza ibyo, kandi ko byo ntibutega uburenganzira bw’undi muntu.
Uremyeze gukoresha website kohereza ibintu byangoeje igihano cyangwa gukanguranya, no gigerageza gushobora site cyangwa kwinjira aho witarugirijwe.

sections.title: Ubutimwa bw’umubiri
paragraphs: Igaragaza, ibinyandiko, code n’amarangamutuma ya website ni bya King Business Studio niba ntabwo byarandikwe ko ari ibindi. Ushobora kureba website no gushyiramo ku mpapuro kugira ngo wibuze. Ntabwo ari ngombwa gukoporora byakoporowe k’ubucuruzi ngo ubibere ukurenganzira bwanditswe.
Nyir’ubugimari bw’akazi yakozwe ku mukiriya bushyirizwa mu masezerano y’umushinga.

sections.title: Serivisi z’abandi
paragraphs: Website ikoresha Formspree kwohereza ifashiko na Google Fonts kugirira imyandiko. Ibikoreshwa byabo birashobora gukoreshwa hakurikijwe amategeko yabo n’amategeko y’ubwibone.

Ubufasha bw’abashobisha ni gahinga ku macye y'itegeko asanzwe, bukayikora amakuru ava kuri iyi website. Ntabwo ari umuntu kandi ntibukoresha AI generative. Amakuru akabyatanga ugomba kuzakemezwa mbere yo kurikira.

sections.title: Guhindura igitangiro
paragraphs: Hafi gukoresha website, King Business Studio ntibashobora kubazwa igifungo mu buryo buvuganye mu miterere y’uburenganzira. Nta kuri iyi mategeko bibuzwa ibintu byakemezweho n’amategeko.

sections.title: Uhoyane
paragraphs: Ibibazo ku mategeko ni byohereza mu ifashiko ry’uhoyane. Email y’ikigo y’umusanzwe izongerwa hano igihe yemejwe.
